_comment: Tier-2 for dune::eigenvalue#1 and dune::eigenvalue#3, measured 2026-08-06 on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, wall time 23 s (no new JIT; the cost is two dense 625x625 generalised eigensolves, which are what let the fixture COUNT and LOCATE modes rather than sample them). On a 24x24 P1 grid: 625 dofs, 96 boundary, 529 interior. The galerkin scheme's constrained rows ARE identity rows (unit diagonal, row absolute sum 1), which makes the matrix NON-SYMMETRIC — max|Ac - Ac^T| = 0.333333 — so eigsh's symmetry assumption is violated silently. The constrained pencil has 625 modes against the physical 529, i.e. exactly 96 extra, and greedy matching against the physical spectrum leaves exactly 96 unmatched. The fix works: the interior submatrices reproduce pi^2(m^2+n^2) to 5.72e-03 over the lowest four modes (1.18e-02 by the sixth, which is Q1 discretisation error growing with mode number, not pollution) and keep the analytically degenerate (1,2)/(2,1) pair degenerate to 2.8e-12. eigsh with which='LM' and no sigma returned 1.3141e+04, above 1/h^2 = 5.76e+02 — the mesh-artefact end. TWO SPECIFICS OF THE CATALOG CLAIM ARE FALSIFIED HERE and the fixture asserts the counter-evidence so they cannot creep back: (1) the extra eigenvalues are NOT at 1/M_ii — the boundary dofs give only the two values 2592.0 and 5184.0, and ZERO of the 96 extra modes lies within 1e-3 relative of either; they run from 494.3 to 13560.2; (2) sigma=0 does NOT 'return them first' — shift-invert on the constrained pencil came back with 19.7502, 49.4317, 49.4391, 79.0477, i.e. the physical modes, to 7.15e-03. The extra modes all sit above 494.3 while the first physical eigenvalue is 19.7674.
